title: The difficulties of the transition: coups and removals
goal: Read how presidents fell or tried to break the rules in the 1990s, using dejar de + infinitive.

items: I can say what power the military kept in Chile after 1990.
I can say what happened to Collor in Brazil, Fujimori in Peru, Serrano in Guatemala and Pérez in Venezuela.
I can explain why the crises ended without a new military government.
I can say what stopped with *dejar de* + infinitive: *los militares dejaron de gobernar*.
